listExempt.irregular-mnemonic: DIS HES mnemonic expansion kept for saved-card identity; each verb is practised atomically by irregular-dar/ir/saber/haber/estar/ser.
listExempt.weirdo-mnemonic: WEIRDO mnemonic expansion kept for saved-card identity; the trigger contexts are practised atomically by the cloze cards and rule-certainty-indicative / rule-same-subject-infinitive.

reclassified.real-condition: Asks the learner to interpret how two example sentences differ (comprehension), not to recall a rule; concept → rule (qa). The declarative rule is now rule-open-condition-indicative / rule-hypothetical-si.

listExempt.arrow-mnemonic: Memory-hook expansion kept for saved-card identity; each meaning is recalled atomically by rule-cause-por / rule-exchange-por / rule-purpose-para / rule-deadline-para and practised by the por-*/para-* clozes.

reclassified.habitual-present: Asks the learner to produce a Spanish sentence ("Give a natural Spanish sentence…"), an application task, not declarative recall; concept → rule (qa). The rule itself is now rule-habitual-simple-present.
reclassified.future-plan-choice: Asks the learner to translate an English plan into Spanish ("How would you naturally announce…"), an application task; concept → rule (qa). The rule itself is now rule-future-plan-not-progressive.

answerChanged.augmentative-tone: Tightened to the single contrast the yes/no front asks about; removed a four-item list of senses. The target (No: not necessarily praise) is unchanged.
